response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates extensive experience in software engineering and leadership, including roles as a Staff Software Engineer and Senior Developer. His focus on AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling at re:cinq is relevant, though his primary expertise appears more aligned with software craftsmanship and general engineering rather than specialized AI strategy. The lack of a Master's/PhD in an AI-related field and limited direct AI product development experience slightly detracts from his fit for a director-level AI strategy role.
strengths: Strong software engineering background with 15+ years of experience across multiple languages and domains
Proven leadership in technical roles, including founding GISCollective and contributing to open-source projects
Experience with cloud technologies (AWS CDK) and modern AI-related tooling (MCP, agentic workflows)
concerns: Limited demonstrated expertise in core AI/ML technologies or building AI-powered products/platforms
No clear evidence of entrepreneurial or startup experience within larger organizations
No advanced degree (Master's/PhD) in an AI-related field, which is preferred for this role
